# copick export alignment

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Export alignments to AreTomo3, Warp, RELION, IMOD or the CryoET Data Portal format.*

## Usage

```bash
copick export alignment [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Converts each run's selected alignment from copick's CETS frame to the tool's frame and row order: AreTomo3
'<run>.aln' with '<run>_TLT.txt', Warp '<run>.xml', RELION 'tomograms.star' with 'tilt_series/<run>.star' for all
runs, IMOD '<run>/<run>.xf/.tlt/.xtilt' with tilt.com and newst.com, or '<run>_alignment.json'. RELION's
rlnTomoNominalStageTiltAngle holds the nominal tilt angles, and its pre-exposure the accumulated dose.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--run-names, -r` | text · multiple | — | Specific run names to process (default: all runs). Repeatable; pass -r once per run. |
| `--alignment-uri` | text | **required** | Alignments to export, one per run (e.g. 'aretomo3' or '*@raw?default=true'). |
| `--output-dir` | directory | **required** | Output directory for exported files. |
| `--output-format` | choice (aretomo3 \| warp \| relion \| imod \| cdp) | **required** | Format to write. |
| `--reference-tomogram` | text | — | Each run's tomogram ('tomo_type@voxel_size') the tool should reconstruct. Default: the alignment's reference volume. |
| `--include-ctf` | boolean flag | `False` | Also write the CTF fits of the tilt series. |
| `--drop-x-tilt` | boolean flag | `False` | AreTomo3: drop the tilt about x, which .aln files cannot represent. |
| `--hand` | float | `-1.0` | RELION: rlnTomoHand. |
| `--relion-tomo-name` | text | — | RELION: rlnTomoName of a single exported run. Default: the run name. |
| `--assume-frame` | choice (half \| floor) | — | IMOD only: centre convention for odd image or volume sizes. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
# The default alignment of every run's raw tilt series, for RELION 5 with CTF
copick export alignment -c config.json --alignment-uri "*@raw?default=true" --output-dir relion \
    --output-format relion --include-ctf
```
